title: A New Book Asks, What Is Canada?
summary: “Elbows Up!” is a collection of essays by prominent Canadians like Margaret Atwood that seeks to make something positive out of Canada’s identity angst.

title: Amazon awkwardly edited the guns out of James Bond art
summary: Last week, for James Bond Day, Amazon revealed updated poster art for the movies.
